answer: Honest work runs 36 minutes a proof; the farm needs 150 proofs, which is 5400 minutes it cannot paint. The strongest wall I know is Grist weigher buckwheat toll milled at the sifting loft, and it is built out of each buckwheat is a milling record witnessed by the toll keeper. A farm can rehearse the anchor and rehearse the mirror, but it cannot rehearse the prism, because a year will not rehearse. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath.
